name: Whip Pan — Scene Switch
description: Fast whip pan that transitions between two scenes — a classic reel transition.
thumbnailPrompt: motion-blurred whip pan transition between two colorful scenes, vertical format

inputs.label: Scene A
inputs.placeholder: espresso being poured in a sunlit cafe

inputs.label: Scene B
inputs.placeholder: the finished latte art on a marble table

promptTemplate: Dynamic whip pan transition shot: opens on {sceneA}, then the camera whips violently to the right with heavy directional motion blur and lands cleanly on {sceneB}. Fast snappy energy, smartphone gimbal cinematography, 24mm wide lens, punchy saturated color grade, tack-sharp start and end frames with pure motion blur mid-transition, seamless single take feel, made for short-form vertical video.
negativePrompt: cuts, freeze frames, text, watermark, murky colors, low energy
